prompt: Sentence-BERT makes semantic search practical because it produces sentence embeddings that can be precomputed and compared with cosine similarity, instead of running BERT on every sentence pair.
explanation: The SBERT paper notes that finding the most similar pair among 10,000 sentences takes about 50 million BERT inference computations (around 65 hours). With siamese-network embeddings compared via cosine similarity, it takes about 5 seconds at similar accuracy.
